recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. If future itemControl wording changes are needed, apply them in the Extension Pack or SDC guidance rather than restoring retired core source files.
issue_request: FHIR-36105 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire clarification asking that itemControl check-box and radio-button text make clear those controls can also guide boolean questions, and that the Questionnaire Boolean-answer guidance be updated.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 687e88f506f8cf95cbf81d258aac6621c41cde21, which updated the then-core questionnaire-item-control CodeSystem definitions for check-box and radio-button and updated source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml to mention traditional check-box controls in Boolean guidance.
additional_context: Questionnaire remains an active core resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml still contains the Boolean-answer guidance added for this issue. The questionnaire-item-control CodeSystem and ValueSet were later removed from core by dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 and now live in the FHIR Extension Pack, where the migrated CodeSystem retains the FHIR-36105 wording. SDC minutes for 2022-03-10 record the persuasive decision, and community searches found no conflicting later discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current core build source already contains the requested Questionnaire Boolean guidance, while the item-control terminology portion is no longer owned by this checkout and is already correct in the Extension Pack.
